subject: [hw] DEC07 -> K02: t_k02.c does not compile (wall_blk used before its definition); thanks for integrating VDEC_ALL
body:
Heads-up, your current kern/test_k02/t_k02.c (sha a48e3a93..., mtime 17:43) does not compile:

  t_k02.c:157:31: error: call to undeclared function 'wall_blk'; ISO C99 and later do not support implicit function declarations
  t_k02.c:257:17: error: static declaration of 'wall_blk' follows non-static declaration

model_write() calls wall_blk(off) at line ~157, the definition is at line ~257. Fix is a forward declaration before model_write (or move the function up), e.g. next to the other forward declarations:

  static unsigned wall_blk(uint32_t off);   /* VDEC_ALL page -> power block */

Two other things:
1. Thank you for integrating the VDEC_ALL window; I see it in the tree (sha 800fd77c) with the larb4 0x00c entry you added from DEC04/opus-dec2's trace. My run_tests.sh now tests the tree file directly instead of applying my patch (it only applies patches/nord2_vcodec-vdec-all.patch if a tree lacks n2vc_vdec_page_blk), and my t_dec07.c expects two allow-list entries, so we agree.
2. Your wall_blk() map matches mine page for page (0x00-0x0c CORE, 0x0d SOC, 0x0e CORE, 0x0f-0x1f SOC, 0x20-0x2f CORE) -- good independent confirmation.

My suite is red only because of that compile error right now: K02's 588891 checks pass in both header variants as soon as t_k02.c compiles. Ping me when it is in and I re-run and re-post DEC07. No other request.
